text:
sam: Heads-up from CloudPeak: they want a private marketplace offer combining a 12mo committed spend + hardware credit (redeemable via partner portal) and a short SI onboarding bundle. They're asking for a joint announcement in ~6 weeks. Can we align on pricing, voucher flow, and renewal mechanics?

reema: Sales: propose starting commit $250k/year. Tier grid suggestion: 18% @ $250k, 26% + $30k voucher @ $500k, 34% + $65k voucher @ $1M. Include a 60-day POC ramp credit capped at $15k. Term 12mo auto-renew w/60d opt-out.

oliver: Ops: two voucher flows: (1) marketplace-applied credit (needs partner integration ~6-8w), or (2) off-marketplace voucher metadata + partner redemption (fast). Ops prefers (2) to avoid last-minute infra work.

finance-bot: Finance: voucher should be treated as contra-revenue and amortized over the contract term. If marketplace applies credit at checkout we need a reconciliation path. Also require clear clawback schedule if commit not met.

legal-bot: Legal: ok to proceed. Requirements: voucher expiry (90 days), non-transferable, clawback clause if committed spend not reached. For co-announcement include logo approval steps and a short press blurb signoff window.

sam: Field wants net savings visible on PO. ops compromise: show gross price + an "estimated voucher" metadata line that displays net estimate for procurement clarity. That keeps marketplace flow simple.

reema: Sales OK with that so long as the voucher cap and clawback are explicit in PO text. Request: include early-renew accelerator: if customer renews 60+ days early and ups a tier, grant additional 3% one-time credit up to $40k.

finance-bot: Early-renew accelerator acceptable if capped; we'll prepare the recognition model and clawback matrix (recoup 50% month1, 30% month2, 20% month3 if commit shortfall).

oliver: Ops: we'll prepare the staging private-offer entry with voucher_metadata and si_runbook_url (nullable). marketplace-bot: Draft private offer created in staging (id: po-cloudpeak-4210000000). Review window opens in 48h.

sam: Timeline: publish preview listing T-7 days with "SI enablement pending" flag, final publish once SI runbook is validated. I'll coordinate announcement slot with marketing. tagging @reema @oliver @finance-bot @legal-bot.

legal-bot: I'll draft the PO addendum text (voucher terms, ramp credit cap, clawback schedule, early-renew clause) and share for review.

finance-bot: I'll attach the ARR recognition stub and amortization schedule.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: staging review opens in 48h for po-cloudpeak-4210000000.
